description.comment: Polyacanthonotus merretti (Bahamas spiny eel) is a species in the Notacanthidae family. This sample from the Gulf of Mexico near Louisiana was provided by Prosanta Chakrabarty of the LSU Museum of Natural Science, Section of Ichthyology and coordinated by Paul Hime of Washington University in St. Louis to generate a high-quality reference genome for the Vertebrate Genomes Project (VGP). Sequencing and genome assembly were conducted at the Vertebrate Genome Lab (VGL) at the Rockefeller University, led by Erich D. Jarvis, Giulio Formenti, and Jennifer Balacco.

assembly_info.comments: Curator note: There is no known karyotype for this species. 2n=26 chromosomes were identified based on Hi-C signal and telomeres. Based on the Hi-C signal, the sample appears to be heterogemetic, but the sex determination system of this species is not known and the sex of the sample was not determined. Thus, we have placed these putative sex chromosomes into haplotype 1 (chromosomes 13 and 14), but we have not labelled them as sex chromosomes. We are unsure of order and orientation in chromosome 12 between 38.9-43.5Mbp.
